newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Central Bank sells 240 bln rbls of bills.
newsitem.headline: Russian Central Bank sells 240 bln rbls of bills.

text.p: The central bank sold 240.00 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Tuesday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 23007 issue closed on Tuesday at 84.00 percent, and the 21075 issue closed at 83.28 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
Full details of recent central bank transactions in the secondary market for the Finance Ministry can be seen on CBGKOSEC.
